uiux.title: SafeMom
uiux.description: A clinician-facing early-warning flow for preeclampsia risk in Kenyan antenatal clinics, designed to fit inside a routine visit instead of adding work to it.
features: Short data entry using only inputs available at the visit
Neutral risk flag with the reasons behind it
Result page redesigned from a usability and clinical-safety audit
